name: rmc-platform
description: Rwanda Muslim Community Digital Platform — monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,file-server -c green,cyan,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=apps/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/file-server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/backend && npm run build --workspace=apps/frontend && npm run build --workspace=apps/file-server
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend,file-server -c green,cyan,yellow "npm run start --workspace=apps/backend" "npm run start --workspace=apps/frontend" "npm run start --workspace=apps/file-server"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/backend && npm run test --workspace=apps/frontend && npm run test --workspace=apps/file-server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/backend && npm run lint --workspace=apps/frontend && npm run lint --workspace=apps/file-server
scripts.install:all: npm install --workspace=apps/backend && npm install --workspace=apps/frontend && npm install --workspace=apps/file-server
